enedkeg-ün ubadini ǰin-a mitr-a kiged yeke nayiraγuluγci bande yeses sde kelemürci orciγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai, töbed-ün kelen-ece mongγol-un ayalγu-dur toyin bsinpa gunding gusi orciγulbai,
hindkeg-ün ubadini ǰ"ina mitr-a kiged / yeke kelemüči badi yê sendsdi orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orosibai, töbed-ün kelen-eče mongγol-un / ayalγu-tur toyin bsinba günding güsei orčiγulba. , .
